research_window.note: Exact scan from the prior accepted open-branch boundary. Three new federal records and two material same-event refreshes met the threshold; weaker, pending and duplicate leads were withheld rather than padded.

publication_authorization: The user authorizes maintenance branches, pull requests and merging after evidence, local acceptance and successful CI; repository policy still requires Phillip Linstrum's final publication acceptance before merge.

changes.summary: CMS removed Marketplace subsidies associated with about 189,000 duplicate or deceased records under a dispute and appeal process.
changes.duplicate_review: Distinct implemented record-level payment action, not another general ACA fraud estimate.

changes.summary: OCC published final supervisory findings that all nine reviewed banks had policies capable of influencing debanking on subjective grounds.
changes.duplicate_review: Distinct nine-bank measured report, not an individual account dispute or lawsuit.

changes.summary: September CPI rose 0.6% monthly and 3.7% annually, with gasoline accounting for more than half of the monthly rise.
changes.duplicate_review: Next monthly observation consolidated into the stable CPI series record.

changes.summary: SSA set the automatic 2027 COLA at 3.6% and published related tax and earnings thresholds.
changes.duplicate_review: Separate statutory benefit effect derived from CPI-W, not another consumer-price record.

changes.summary: Bank of America reported repositioning about 1,000 employees and investing in consent-order remediation.
changes.duplicate_review: Same enforcement and remediation event consolidated into its stable record.
